args.name: Restore a renewable food supply
args.function: Provide a learnable practical method to cultivate or tend depleted edible plants so that sustained work can produce a renewable food supply under suitable physical conditions.
args.conditions: At tick 94 my health is 100, satiety 79.4 and energy about 22.56. A bounded root search ended after collecting zero roots because no reachable ripe sources or unseen observed ground remained in its area. Several personally observed local food plants were empty. I own two roots and 0.9 berry. Roots have recorded nutrition 14 and toxicity zero. Local soil is ordinary with moisture 0.65.
args.inputs: Existing food plants, suitable ground, and whatever planting material, tools or water a feasible method requires. Required inputs and propagation methods are unknown; possession of roots does not establish that they can be planted.
args.costs: Unknown. Specify realistic learning time, effort, materials, growth time and prerequisites. No free food, instant replenishment or presumed mastery.
args.effects: Enable a physical trial of cultivation or plant tending with observable progress and a conditional harvest, respecting resource stocks, growing conditions and failure possibilities.

candidates.effects: Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

candidates.function: Describe an encountered problem, desired effect and known conditions for functional review.
candidates.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
candidates.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

candidates.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
candidates.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
candidates.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

candidates.function: Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Heard like tell, and leaves an invitation sign where you stand until 10 rounds after the meeting. At that round an attendance event records who is within 2.5 units of the place. No physical effect.

candidates.function: Search an area around an origin for sources of one known resource and collect up to a quantity, one navigate, probe or gather step per round, within path, time and energy limits.
candidates.costs: No cost of its own: each round runs one ordinary step at its own cost. navigate: actual distance x 2 energy, raised by ground and carried mass, at most 0.8 distance per round; probe observe: 1 round, 0.2 energy; gather: 1 round, 2 energy per unit. Each step is priced first against the path, time and energy left and the energy reserve; a step that does not fit is not taken and the search stops. time counts every round since start, paused ones too. Study: 1 round; needs navigate, probe and gather.
candidates.effects: start: resource, radius around x, y (default your position), path, time, energy, reserve, quantity. Candidates: sources of that resource you see now, or remember out of view, inside the radius, with ripe stock; nearest reach first; sources made by another person are left alone. It walks to one with navigate, inspects it with probe, then gathers min(stock, quantity left, units the energy allows). Sources seen empty are noted, not visited. If none is known it may walk to observed dry ground inside the radius to see its unseen parts; one known but beyond the limits stops it. It completes at the quantity or when nothing is left (perhaps with 0), and stops at a limit, health <= 60, satiety <= 8, body temperature 10 from 22 or an injury in the last round. Another action pauses it; resume rechecks all; cancel or death ends it. Nothing is refunded, created or eaten; no reward.

candidates.function: Give a name of up to 60 characters to this place (empty subject) or to a visible object or nearby item; naming the same subject again replaces your name for it.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Leaves a persistent name sign where you stand that nearby people can see. No physical effect.

candidates.function: Leave a mark or inscription of up to 120 characters on the ground here (empty subject) or on an object or item within reach.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Leaves a persistent mark sign where you stand that nearby people can see; your 24 most recent names and marks persist. No physical effect.

candidates.function: Recover available physical energy at the current position.
candidates.effects: Base recovery 4, modified by actually accessible registered facilities; capped at 40.
